subject: general
question: Six children, F, G, H, I, J and K, were examined for intelligence and were given marks according to their performance in the test. Each child scored different marks. H scored more than J. H scored less than G and K. J scored less than I. F scored more than G. Who among the six children scored the least?
solution:
**Given: **Six children, F, G, H, I, J and K, were examined for intelligence and were given marks according to their performance in the test. Each child scored different marks. 

1) H scored more than J.

2) H scored less than G and K.

G / K > H > J

3) F scored more than G.

Case 1) F > G / K > H > J

Case 2) K > F > G > H > J

4) J scored less than I. 

Case 1) F > G / K > H > J F > G > H > J < I

Thus, in both cases, J scored the least.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
